en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad avenue lined with mid‑20th‑century buildings. People walk and cycle along the sidewalks and street. To the right is a corner building signed as a bank, and in the distance stands a prominent historic building with a tall clock‑tower–like structure. The foreground signage and caption identify the location as Haparanda and the street as Köpmangatan.
